name: flowchart
description: Evaluate and improve Flowchart drawings — a process with steps, decisions and branches
goal: Reach a consistent 16+/20, with every node connected and drawn from a BASFLO_M.VSSX master

prompts.text: Build a flowchart for order fulfilment from receipt through picking, packing, dispatch and delivery confirmation
Build a flowchart for incident response from detection through triage, containment, remediation and review
Build a flowchart for expense approval with a decision on amount, routing under 500 to the line manager and above to finance
Build a flowchart for employee onboarding from offer acceptance through contract, equipment, accounts and first-day induction
Build a flowchart for product returns with a decision on warranty status, branching to repair, replace or reject
